ctx.x: Capitol I didn't think had one.

Yeah, they had one and Irv Jerome was head of it. I don't think it was once. Irv Jerome. Well, I know Irv good -- I mean Jerry good. Jerry used to take me on gigs, you know, me and Tyree. So now Irv come in and one night he was in and we was talking and the people was enjoying it, you know, enjoying the music, so he says, 'You know what? Dave Cavanaugh's in town from California. I'm going to have him to come in here and listen to you one night, you know. Can't ever tell what will happen, you know.' I said, 'Yeah.…
can do a better one. I don't know what kind of contract you've got or if you've got one. Tell him I think we can do a better job."
